adds.title: U.S. Department of State 2011 Human Rights Report on Malawi
adds.summary: In 2011 Malawi amended Penal Code Section 137 to criminalize indecent practices between females punishable by up to five years' imprisonment while retaining criminalization of unnatural offenses and indecent practices between males punishable by up to 14 years' imprisonment, leaving consensual same-sex activity illegal and exposing gender-nonconforming and same-sex-partnered visitors to arrest, prosecution, and societal discrimination.
